address: 3/4 Soi Sukhumvit 43, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Helmed by a Portuguese chef who injects Japanese cuisine with his unique flair, this restaurant follows an Edomae-style meal progression. Seasonal catch flown from Tokyo and Kanazawa is paired with sushi rice seasoned with three vinegars for perfect balance. Highlights include luscious ankimo tucked into crispy rice-flour wafers. The modest room with an eight-seat counter feels intimate, and the English-speaking chef's engaging service adds to the experience....
